# SF3301 SV schematic: English annotation companion

Source: `SF3301_SV_Schematic_v1.0.pdf` in artifact `vendors-sfards-sf3301-source`. Scope: all Chinese annotations visible in the four schematic sheets. All four rendered sheets were checked. Net names, component designators, values, and existing English notes remain in the original schematic. AI translation; not human reviewed.

The filename says v1.0. The schematic title blocks say revision 0.4. Preserve both labels.

| Sheet | Annotation location | English translation |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | Beside P1 serial connector | Serial cable: straight-through connection. |
| 4 | Below PU1 | Chip cooling-fan power connector. |
| 4 | Below PU1 | Put four fan mounting holes and two heatsink mounting holes on the PCB. |
| 4 | MR2 / MR1 note | MR2 and MR1: LR1575GTED0M50N, power rating 5 W. |
| 4 | Current-measurement formula | `Vo` is in volts; the resulting current is in amperes. |
| 4 | TP6 to TP14 group | Board mounting holes. |
| 4 | HEADSINK1 / HEADSINK2 | Heatsink mounting holes. |
| 4 | FAN1 to FAN4 | Cooling-fan mounting holes. |

Sheets 1 and 2 contain no Chinese prose annotations visible in the checked rendering.
